review_type: Review of retained executed evidence against current game sources; no new game build or runtime execution in this review.
target: macOS ARM64 client and dedicated headless server

criteria.summary: T05 retained two isolated client/server exports from identical inputs, pinned engine/templates, separate renderer/headless settings and actual packaged client close paths. The final T07 clean build and visible client capture use the exact current source inputs.

The final exported-server log records dedicated-server build identity, independent rules/content versions, headless display, Dummy audio, no client scene or local player, and three completed heartbeat iterations with passing executed assertions.

T04 executed 60 configuration cases; the configuration loader, server root and committed configuration fixtures remain unchanged. T06 inspected bundle and decoded packed resources with synthetic private inputs and detected deliberate leaks. The export policy and both inspector implementations remain unchanged. T07 independently retained a clean inspection of the final client and an actionable missing-rules startup rejection.

T07 retained distinct actual build failure with runtime Not Executed, executed assertion failure, startup rejection with no assertion pass, bounded timeout with process cleanup, and an independent fresh passing exported-server run. Intentional failure controls have their expected nonzero outcomes.

manual_client_review: Inspected retained client-window.png showing Briarwake client baseline and Quit; client-launch.json records visible launch, Quit exit 0 and unchanged bundle hash for the final automated build.

review_checklist.scope: Only epic completion tracking, review evidence and generated documentation change. No game implementation, standards or contracts changed.
review_checklist.source_and_ownership: Canonical roadmap registry owns status. All 36 final tested input files match the clean current game checkout.
review_checklist.verification: All four epic criteria have actual retained execution evidence; intentional failure controls are distinguished from failing current implementation evidence. Documentation validation is recorded separately.
review_checklist.not_applicable: New GDScript, scene, networking, persistence, lifecycle, abstraction and domain-rule checks: no implementation changes.
review_checklist.git_safety: Both repositories began clean. No branches, commits, pushes, pull requests or deployments performed.
review_checklist.final_diff: Passed: BW-001 changes only status and appended completion evidence in the canonical registry. Generated status, prerequisite, dashboard and milestone counts agree. Game checkout and protected standards remain unchanged. Concurrent BW-002 ticket additions and their generated outputs were preserved; final builder drift checks include them.

not_rerun: server runtime smoke and failure controls
